High-resolution (600 dpi) image of strangewayes' print-ready errata card for SW-4 Ion Cannon, a fan re-set (not a Players Committee or Decipher publication; Decipher's own errata is [[SW-4 Ion Cannon (Decipher Errata 1998)]]) (A New Hope, Light Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Errata/Light_E/SW4 Ion Cannon _ E.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/1jhDzoNirZIGt_mv-O2hvPibljZ_G6vN2/view Drive file]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261112010640/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html Internet Archive].

Original TIFF: <code>SW4 Ion Cannon _ E.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,340,444 bytes, SHA-256 <code>652bd0199f3102e9f07aa8306de8349fab119c7af945be3926139defedc2f64d</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 44.5, 47.5, 72.5, 57.0 px); resized: no; no other change.

It is listed in the card's versions list as “strangewayes print (fan re-set)”; it is not shown on the Decipher Errata or Players Committee version pages.

Credit: image by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project. Fair use rationale: this is an image of a copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.. It is used only to identify and study the card on this non-commercial fan wiki, it does not replace any product sold today, and no free equivalent exists.
